clue.text: In Rome that is time for bumping off!

definitions.text: In Rome that is time for bumping off!

indicators.note: bumping off means getting rid of, so the letter for time is knocked out of the Latin phrase

parts.note: the Latin for 'that is' is id est, as a Roman would say it

explanation.surface: An exclamation about the Roman date on which murder was the order of the day.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for bumping off' removes T from IDEST. The whole clue also defines: the Ides of March was the day Julius Caesar was assassinated in Rome.
explanation.definitionFit: Caesar was stabbed on the Ides of March, the mid-month day of the Roman calendar, making it the classic murder date.

clue.text: Prevent officer stopping car, in belief that we have no real choice

definitions.text: belief that we have no real choice

indicators.note: here the officer is the stopper at the end of the car, closing it off

parts.note: to deter is to prevent or discourage
the Mini is a classic small British car
SM is short for sergeant major, a senior army officer

explanation.surface: A policeman pulls over a vehicle, oddly in the name of a philosophy of fate.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stopping' here means acting as the stopper that closes off the car's end, not sitting inside it; the Mini is a classic small British car.
explanation.definitionFit: Determinism is the philosophical doctrine that all events are fixed by prior causes, leaving no free will.

clue.text: Winter journey, for example, by air and bike

parts.note: an air is a tune or song
to bike is to cycle

explanation.surface: A seasonal trip made by plane and bicycle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Winter journey' is Winterreise, Schubert's famous set of linked songs, not a trip in cold weather.
explanation.definitionFit: Schubert's Winterreise is the best-known example of a set of songs meant to be performed in sequence.

clue.text: Possibly it'll start to rise up, so opening in castle appears

definitions.text: Possibly it'll start to rise up, so opening in castle appears

indicators.note: possibly signals that the letters could be arranged another way
the start to a word is its first letter

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

indicators.note: the opening in a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: Describes a castle gate grinding upwards to reveal the way in.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Possibly' rearranges ITLL, R (start to 'rise'), UP, SO and C (opening in 'castle'). The whole clue also pictures the grille being raised.
explanation.definitionFit: A portcullis is the heavy grille that rises to open, or drops to close, a castle gateway.

clue.text: One in landing-place is explorer

indicators.note: one word set in another, placed within its letters

parts.note: a pier is a landing-stage for boats
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone standing on a jetty turns out to be an adventurer.
explanation.definitionFit: A pioneer is one who first explores or settles new territory, so an explorer.

clue.text: It could be that sister maybe awfully poor nun

parts.note: a sister is an example of a relative

indicators.note: awfully suggests the letters are mangled into a new order

explanation.surface: Maybe that's my sister, a dreadfully impoverished nun.
explanation.walkthrough: 'awfully' rearranges POORNUN into PRONOUN. 'that' in the definition is meant as the word itself, as in 'the book that I read'.
explanation.definitionFit: In grammar the word 'that' can introduce a relative clause, making it an example of this part of speech.

clue.text: Sweet animal artist captured

indicators.note: captured means held inside, so one piece goes within the other

parts.note: a camel is an animal
RA stands for Royal Academician, an artist

explanation.surface: A painter has caught a cute creature.
explanation.definitionFit: Caramel is a toffee-like confection, a sweet in British usage.

clue.text: Girl getting a Christmas over

indicators.note: over means turned over, so the word for Christmas is read backwards

parts.note: Noel is another name for Christmas

explanation.surface: A young woman is given something once the festive season ends.
explanation.definitionFit: Leona is a girl's name, the feminine form of Leon.

clue.text: Superior quality to be restricted by nasty Left

indicators.note: restricted by means held within the letters of the following words

explanation.surface: Excellence is held back by unpleasant left-wingers.
explanation.definitionFit: Style means distinction or elegance, a superior quality of manner or design.

clue.text: Starchy type with a stud in Berkshire

definitions.text: Starchy type with a stud in Berkshire

parts.words: Starchy type with a stud in Berkshire
parts.note: reads like a stiff person who keeps a stallion in a home county, but means a stiff white neckband fastened with a stud, worn at a school in Berkshire

explanation.surface: A prim country gentleman who keeps a breeding horse in Berkshire.
explanation.walkthrough: Eton College is in Berkshire, a county west of London; its pupils traditionally wore a broad starched white collar fastened with a stud.
explanation.definitionFit: The Eton collar is a wide stiff white collar fastened with a stud, named after the Berkshire public school.

clue.text: Pass alongside fish

parts.note: to pass is to go
by means beside or alongside

explanation.surface: Swimming past next to a fish.
explanation.definitionFit: The goby is a small fish found in coastal waters.

clue.text: Wise man may be learner among old people

indicators.note: among means placed in the midst of something

parts.note: a race is a people
L for learner, as on British learner-driver plates

explanation.surface: A sage might just be a student amid elderly folk.
explanation.definitionFit: An oracle is a person of great wisdom whose pronouncements are taken as authoritative.

clue.text: Sacred building fitted with a temperature gauge

indicators.note: fitted with means having something installed inside

parts.note: a temple is a sacred building

explanation.surface: A church has a thermometer installed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'temperature gauge' reads as one thing, but 'gauge' alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A template is a pattern or gauge used as a guide for shaping or cutting.

clue.text: End one race after limited time

indicators.note: after means following, so the period comes first

parts.note: a term is a fixed, limited period
I is the Roman numeral one
a nation is a race of people

explanation.surface: A runner finishes a race after a short spell.
explanation.definitionFit: Termination is a synonym for an end or conclusion.

clue.text: In Olympic event, American failed to make record

indicators.note: failed to make means did not appear, so those letters drop out

parts.note: the discus is a throwing event in the Olympics

explanation.surface: An American athlete misses out on a world record in a throwing competition.
explanation.definitionFit: A disc is a gramophone record, from the shape of the vinyl.

clue.text: Article on party by politician spilling secrets

indicators.note: on means placed after, so the article follows the party

parts.note: a revel is a lively party
a is the indefinite article
a Tory is a British Conservative politician

explanation.surface: A news story about a politician's party lets cats out of bags.
explanation.definitionFit: Revelatory means making things known, disclosing what was hidden or secret.

clue.text: Don't agree to bring the children along

parts.note: bring along means take
issue means offspring or children

explanation.surface: Objecting to the kids being brought along.
explanation.walkthrough: 'along' just completes the phrase 'bring along', meaning take.
explanation.definitionFit: To take issue is an idiom for disagreeing or disputing something.

clue.text: Shed —- place I renovated to be a religious sanctum

indicators.note: renovated means done up, so these letters are rebuilt in a new order

explanation.surface: A garden shed renovated into a little chapel.
explanation.definitionFit: A side chapel is a small chapel within a church, a place of private worship.

clue.text: Percy's part of capital team

definitions.meaning: Percy is, here meaning Sir Henry Percy, the knight of Shakespeare's Henry IV nicknamed for his rashness
part of the name of a London football club, Tottenham

explanation.surface: Someone called Percy plays for a London side.
explanation.walkthrough: Tottenham Hotspur is a London football club, named after Harry Percy, the medieval knight.
explanation.definitionFit: Hotspur was the nickname of Sir Henry Percy and is also part of Tottenham's club name.

clue.text: Gaps woman discovered in material

indicators.note: discovered in means found inside the next piece

parts.note: lace is a fabric
Una is a woman's name

explanation.surface: Holes found where a woman is in fabric.
explanation.definitionFit: Lacunae are gaps or missing portions, the plural of lacuna.

clue.text: Thus make set of clothes for knight to wear?

indicators.note: to wear means to have on, so the clothes surround the knight

parts.note: a kit is a set of clothes, as in football kit
N is the chess abbreviation for knight

explanation.surface: Making a costume for a knight to put on.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Thus' and 'for' link the definition to the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: To knit is to make garments from yarn with needles.

clue.text: Treat, to break into a second liqueur

indicators.note: into means placed inside the other piece

parts.note: a mo is a moment, a second

indicators.note: break means smash up, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A treat breaks in on a short moment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'break' rearranges TREAT into ARETT, which goes 'into' A MO.
explanation.definitionFit: Amaretto is an Italian almond-flavoured liqueur.

clue.text: Book man wants to throw off aircraft shortly

parts.note: Al is a man's name

indicators.note: shortly means cut short, so the last letter goes

parts.note: to bump a passenger is to throw them off an overbooked flight

explanation.surface: A man wants to eject someone from a plane quickly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shortly' cuts the last letter from BUMP.
explanation.definitionFit: An album is a book with blank pages for photos or stamps.

clue.text: Being a grand short is concerning stingy types

indicators.note: short means missing its last letter

parts.note: a grand is a grand piano

explanation.surface: A tight-fisted lot are a thousand pounds down.
explanation.walkthrough: 'grand' suggests a thousand, but it is the piano; 'stingy types' are bees, not misers.
explanation.definitionFit: Apian means relating to bees, which are insects that sting.

clue.text: Highest point around capital shown by a cross

parts.note: C stands for circa, Latin for around
Lima is the capital of Peru
X is a cross

explanation.surface: A peak near a city marked with a cross.
explanation.definitionFit: A climax is the highest or most intense point of something.

clue.text: One of us getting on would still be one of us

definitions.text: One of us getting on would still be one of us

parts.words: One of us getting on would still be one of us
parts.note: reads as a compatriot growing old, but means a short word for a national that, with the two letters of 'on' tacked on, is a longer word for the same national

explanation.surface: A citizen who grows old is still a citizen.
explanation.walkthrough: 'getting on' suggests growing old, but means adding ON to the word.
explanation.definitionFit: Brit is informal for a British person, and adding on gives a fuller word for the same.

clue.text: Making prediction against orthodox believer?

definitions.meaning: ..., in favour of a heretic, is against the orthodox believer

explanation.surface: A forecast against a conventional believer.
explanation.walkthrough: Gnostics were early Christian sects considered heretical, so being pro-Gnostic is against orthodoxy; the question mark flags the pun.
explanation.definitionFit: Prognostic means foretelling or predicting, as of the course of a disease.

clue.text: Protest about dropped sacred vessel

indicators.note: dropped means removed, so those letters leave the word

parts.note: a remonstrance is a forceful protest
re means about or concerning

explanation.surface: A complaint about the loss of a holy container.
explanation.definitionFit: A monstrance is a vessel in which the consecrated Host is displayed in Catholic worship.

clue.text: Bird to make sounds

indicators.note: sounds means spoken aloud, giving the same sound

parts.note: to earn is to make money

explanation.surface: A bird tries to sing.
explanation.definitionFit: An erne is a sea eagle, common in crosswords.
